Rules.InvariantScript:
ForAll(
    Sequence(12, 0, 1) As MonthOffset,
    With(
        { monthAnchor: DateAdd(Date(Year(Today()),4,1), MonthOffset.Value, TimeUnit.Months) },
        With(
            {
                monthName: Text(monthAnchor, "mmmm"),
                dueThisMonth: Filter(
                    Activities,
                    'Active ' = true,
                    Month(EndDate) = Month(monthAnchor),
                    Year(EndDate) = Year(monthAnchor),
                    (varFilterProgramme = "All" || ProgrammeLabel = varFilterProgramme),
                    (varFilterDirectorate = "All" || DirectorateLabel = varFilterDirectorate),
                    (
                        IsBlank(varHomeSearchTerm)
                        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(Title)
                        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower('ActivityDescription ')
                    )
                )
            },
            With(
                {
                    reportsForDueActivities: Filter(
                        colReportsInScope,
                        !IsBlank(LookUp(dueThisMonth, ID = Activity.Id)),
                        (varFilterFY = "All" || 'FinancialYear '.Value = varFilterFY),
                        (varFilterQuarter = "All" || Quarter.Value = varFilterQuarter),
                        (varHomeFilter = "All"
                            || (varHomeFilter = "PendingApprovals" && Status.Value = "Submitted")
                            || (varHomeFilter = "Overdue" && IsOverdue = true)
                            || (varHomeFilter = "Approved" && Status.Value = "Approved")
                            || (varHomeFilter = "Rejected" && Status.Value = "Rejected")
                        )
                    )
                },
                {
                    MonthName: monthName,
                    TotalActivities: CountRows(dueThisMonth),
                    OnTimeCount: CountRows(Filter(reportsForDueActivities, SubmissionDate <= LookUp(dueThisMonth, ID = Activity.Id, DueDate))),
                    LateCount: CountRows(Filter(reportsForDueActivities, SubmissionDate > LookUp(dueThisMonth, ID = Activity.Id, DueDate))),
                    OutstandingCount: Max(0, CountRows(dueThisMonth) - CountRows(Distinct(reportsForDueActivities, Activity.Id)))
                }
            )
        )
    )
)

(Parent.TemplateHeight - 24) - Self.Height // anchors bar to the bottom, grows upward
(Parent.TemplateHeight - 24) - Self.Height   // anchors bar to the bottom, grows upward

With(
    { effectiveFY: If(varFilterFY = "All", varCurrentFY, varFilterFY) },
    ForAll(
        Distinct(
            Filter(Activities, (varFilterProgramme = "All" || ProgrammeLabel = varFilterProgramme)),
            ProgrammeLabel
        ) As Prog,
        With(
            {
                progName: Prog.Value,
                progActivities: Filter(
                    Activities,
                    ProgrammeLabel = Prog.Value,
                    'Active ' = true,
                    (varFilterDirectorate = "All" || DirectorateLabel = varFilterDirectorate)
                )
            },
            With(
                {
                    progReportsFY: Filter(
                        colReportsInScope,
                        ProgrammeLabel = Prog.Value,
                        'FinancialYear '.Value = effectiveFY,
                        (varFilterDirectorateID = "All" || DirectorateLabel = varFilterDirectorateID),
                        (varFilterQuarter = "All" || Quarter.Value = varFilterQuarter)
                    ),
                    progReportsThisMonth: Filter(
                        colReportsInScope,
                        ProgrammeLabel = Prog.Value,
                        'FinancialYear '.Value = effectiveFY,
                        ReportingMonth.Value = varCurrentMonth,
                        (varFilterDirectorateID = "All" || DirectorateLabel = varFilterDirectorateID)
                    )
                },
                {
                    ProgrammeName: progName,
                    TotalActivities: CountRows(progActivities),
                    MonthlyReportedCount: CountRows(Distinct(progReportsThisMonth, Activity.Id)),
                    MonthlyApprovedCount: CountRows(Distinct(Filter(progReportsThisMonth, Status.Value = "Approved"), Activity.Id)),
                    FYApprovedActivityCount: CountRows(Distinct(Filter(progReportsFY, Status.Value = "Approved"), Activity.Id)),
                    MonthlyReportingRate:
                        If(CountRows(progActivities) = 0, 0,
                            RoundUp((CountRows(Distinct(progReportsThisMonth, Activity.Id)) / CountRows(progActivities)) * 100, 0)),
                    MonthlyApprovalRate:
                        If(CountRows(progActivities) = 0, 0,
                            RoundUp((CountRows(Distinct(Filter(progReportsThisMonth, Status.Value = "Approved"), Activity.Id)) / CountRows(progActivities)) * 100, 0)),
                    FYCumulativeRate:
                        If(CountRows(progActivities) = 0, 0,
                            RoundUp((CountRows(Distinct(Filter(progReportsFY, Status.Value = "Approved"), Activity.Id)) / CountRows(progActivities)) * 100, 0)),
                    FlaggedCount: CountRows(Filter(progReportsFY, isFlagged = true))
                }
            )
        )
    )
)

// MonthlyReport_gal.Items — PRODUCTION VERSION, case-insensitive search
Filter(
    colReportsInScope,

    // --- KPI card filter (varHomeFilter) ---
    (varHomeFilter = "All"
        || (varHomeFilter = "PendingApprovals" && Status.Value = "Submitted")
        || (varHomeFilter = "Overdue" && IsOverdue = true)
        || (varHomeFilter = "Approved" && Status.Value = "Approved")
    )

    // --- Dropdown filters ---
    && (varFilterFY = "All" || 'FinancialYear '.Value = varFilterFY)
    && (varFilterProgramme = "All" || ProgrammeLabel = varFilterProgramme)
    && (varFilterDirectorateID = "All" || DirectorateLabel = varFilterDirectorateID)
    && (varFilterQuarter = "All" || Quarter.Value = varFilterQuarter)

    // --- Free-text search, explicitly case-insensitive via Lower() ---
    && (
        IsBlank(varHomeSearchTerm)
        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(Activity.Value)
        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(Project.Value)
        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(ActivityOwnerLabel)
        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(ProjectOwnerLabel)
        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(SubmittedBy.DisplayName)
        || Lower(varHomeSearchTerm) in Lower(ProgressNarrative)
    )
    ||
    (varHomeFilter = "All"
    || (varHomeFilter = "PendingApprovals" && Status.Value = "Submitted")
    || (varHomeFilter = "Overdue" && IsOverdue = true)
    || (varHomeFilter = "Approved" && Status.Value = "Approved")
    || (varHomeFilter = "Rejected" && Status.Value = "Rejected")
)


)
